hook: Split an ordinary stress into the part you can change and the part you can't, and watch different routes light up across an island of ways people cope. Then see what stress does in the body and build a private plan from chips.
outcome: Tell the part of a stressful situation you can change from the part you can't, match problem-focused and emotion-focused coping strategies to each, and know where to get help
sources: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: call, text or chat, available 24/7/365, for everyone (checked 2026-10-26): https://988lifeline.org
